summary: Each component VM needs at least 16 GB RAM, 4 vCPU and 3000 IOPS; storage is 60 GB for gateway, execution, hop and EDA, while control nodes 80 GB with 20 GB under `/var/lib/awx`; hub 60 GB with 40 GB for `/var/lib/pulp`; database 100 GB for `/var/lib/pgsql`. Scale up in 2x steps.
questions: How much disk does automation hub need?
What are the VM requirements for AAP components?
Minimum RAM for an AAP execution node?

answer_card.title: Per-VM minimums (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
All: 16 GB RAM, 4 vCPU, 3000 IOPS.

| Component | Storage |
|---|---|
| Gateway, execution, hop, EDA | 60 GB |
| Control | 80 GB, 20 GB free in `/var/lib/awx` |
| Hub | 60 GB, 40 GB for `/var/lib/pulp` |
| Database | 100 GB for `/var/lib/pgsql` |

Scale in 2x steps.
